actions.name: Multiattack

actions.desc: The incinis transforms into a wave of magma, moving up to its speed in a straight line. Each creature in the path where the incinis moves must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a target takes 21 (6d6) fire damage and, if it is a Large or smaller creature, it is pushed ahead of the incinis and knocked prone in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of where the incinis ends its movement. On a success, a target takes half the damage and is neither pushed nor knocked prone.

actions.name: Wave of Magma

traits.desc: The elemental can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing. A creature that touches the elemental or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 5 (1d10) fire damage and must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or the weapon becomes stuck in the elemental. If the weapon's wielder can't or won't let go of the weapon, the wielder is grappled while the weapon is stuck. While stuck, the weapon can't be used. Until the grapple ends, the wielder takes 5 (1d10) fire damage at the start of each of its turns. To end the grapple, the wielder can release the weapon or pull it free by taking an action to make a DC 16 Strength check and succeeding.

ru.description: Крупный элементаль, мировоззрение: нейтрально-злое. Класс доспеха: 17 (природный доспех). Хиты: 171 (18к10+72). Скорость: ходьба 40 фт.. Характеристики: СИЛ 12, ЛОВ 20, ТЕЛ 18, ИНТ 10, МУД 16, ХАР 10. Сопротивление урону: дробящего, колющего, рубящего. Иммунитет к урону: огнём, ядом. Иммунитет к состояниям: истощение, захват, паралич, окаменение, отравление, положение ничком, удержание, бессознательное состояние. Чувства: тёмное зрение 60 фт., пассивное Восприятие 13. Показатель опасности: 10. Структурированные механики записи: особенностей: 1, действий: 3.
ru.name: Инкинис
